messages:
Elaine: Heads up — preflight for release/v2.4.1 cutoff in ~18h. Can leads confirm green for your stacks? Please call out: version bump, changelog entry, any flaky tests, and blockers.
Mike: ACK. infra stack looks ok but I'm chasing a flaky: tests/auth/test_token_expiry on windows-agent-6. Repro locally.
Priya: Frontend is green. PR #4827 (admin UX tweak) still needs a changelog blurb — who owns that?
Jordan: I'll take changelog. Also running a quick smoke: `./scripts/preflight --suite smoke --region us-west2` — will report back.
ci-bot: CI status: 77/79 jobs passed, 2 running — buildkite/agents/12.2.1 showing one flaky on windows.
Tom: FYI pinned buildkite agent on release branch to 12.1.8 to avoid the regressed docker behavior. Revert suggestion: revert agent upgrade in infra-images.
Sasha: Suggest we hold merges to release/ v2.4.1 until the flaky is triaged. Otherwise we'll get cascade failures.
Jordan: Created changelog stub: changelogs/unreleased/4827.md and added PR link: https://git.example/r/4827
Elaine: Changelog generator is choking on new frontmatter format in a couple PRs — fallback: please add manual entry to changelogs/unreleased and ensure filename is `4827.md`.
Priya: Done — added entry and bumped version in package.json to 2.4.1-rc.1
Mike: I can reproduce the windows flaky; branch fix pushed: fix/windows-auth-flake. Running local matrix, ETA ~40m to validate.
Elaine: OK, plan: freeze merges to release/v2.4.1 now, schedule a green sweep after Mike confirms. Oncall, please kick off the sweep and hold merges until we get all-green :thumbsup:
devops: Scheduled green sweep at 2024-05-21T22:00Z. To manually trigger: `./ci/trigger_green_sweep --branch release/v2.4.1 --skip-qa false`.
ci-bot: Green sweep result: 79/79 jobs passed. No remaining flaky. Release branch unfreeze ok to merge in critical fixes.
